_comment: Pakistan vs. the World — the Week 18 exhibition. Rosters are hand-maintained:
MFL has no concept of these sides, so there is nothing to fetch. Scores come
from Week 18 in the season file; only the split is recorded here.
This is the league's Pro Bowl. Each side fields ONE combined super lineup
built from its managers' best players, and both lineups are the same size —
12 a side in 2024 and 2025. Managers contribute uneven numbers of players
to it (Dante supplied 6 of the World's 12 in 2024; Anand supplied none),
and the sides need not have the same number of MANAGERS. That is not an
imbalance: the lineups are equal, so the totals compare like for like.
derive.mjs throws if the two lineups ever differ in size.
Every GM who played that season must appear on exactly one side. derive.mjs
checks this against the Week 18 scores and fails loudly on a GM who is
missing, duplicated, or on both sides.
First contested in 2024; there is no Week 18 before that.
Add the new season's sides here before running seal-season in January.
